title: DSG PLayIT v2.2.2
changelog:
- Ultra-fast hardware-accelerated folder & video thumbnail loading via Android ContentResolver
- Persistent WebP disk caching for instantaneous thumbnail retrieval (<1ms) on scroll
- Instant keyframe sync seeking (OPTION_CLOSEST_SYNC) eliminating slow video demuxing
- Throttled background decoder concurrency keeping UI scrolling locked at 60/120 FPS
- Reduced thumbnail memory footprint by 50% using optimized RGB_565 bitmaps
- Fixed UI freeze and unresponsiveness when browsing large video folders
